name: zia-dlp-manager
description: Create, read, update, delete, import, and export Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) DLP policies via OneAPI.
longDescription: A production-grade skill for the complete lifecycle management of Zscaler ZIA Data Loss Prevention policies. Supports export to CSV/JSON, bulk import from JSON, field-level updates, and safe deletes — with single, multiple, and slab modes (5/10/50/100). Every write operation requires explicit typed confirmation and produces an audit CSV. Authenticates via Zidentity OAuth2 client_credentials.

entrypoints.name: Export DLP Policies
entrypoints.description: Export DLP rules, engines, dictionaries, notification templates, ICAP servers, and IDM profiles to CSV and/or JSON.

entrypoints.name: Import DLP Rules
entrypoints.description: Create new DLP rules from a JSON source. Supports single, multiple, and slab modes (50/100/ALL).

entrypoints.name: Update DLP Rules
entrypoints.description: Update existing DLP rules with field-level allow-listing. Supports single, multiple, and slab modes (5/10/50/100).

entrypoints.name: Delete DLP Rules
entrypoints.description: Delete DLP rules safely with double confirmation. Supports single, multiple, and slab modes (5/10/50/100).

ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID.description: OneAPI OAuth2 client ID issued by Zidentity.

ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OneAPI OAuth2 client secret issued by Zidentity.

ZSCALER_VANITY_DOMAIN.description: Tenant vanity domain prefix (the value before .zslogin.net).

INPUT_JSON.description: Path to the JSON file used by import, update, and delete operations.

EXPORT_FORMAT.description: Export format: csv, json, or both.

IMPORT_NAME_SUFFIX.description: Optional suffix appended to imported rule names to avoid duplicates.
